## Findings
<a id="findings"></a>

- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-preview.28920490"></a>**1. EventList is a client component, its file beginning with the 'use client' directive, and it imports the ParsedEvent type from '@/types' and EventCard from './EventCard'.**
  [`EventList.tsx:1-4`](../EventList.tsx#L1-L4)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-preview.97fd0b5a"></a>**2. EventCard is a client component, its file beginning with the 'use client' directive, and it imports the ParsedEvent type from '@/types' and Alert from '@/components/common'.**
  [`EventCard.tsx:1-4`](../EventCard.tsx#L1-L4)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-preview.67168661"></a>**3. EventFilter is a client component, its file beginning with the 'use client' directive.**
  [`EventFilter.tsx:1-1`](../EventFilter.tsx#L1-L1)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-preview.7c45d4cc"></a>**4. BulkActions is a client component, its file beginning with the 'use client' directive, and it imports Button from '@/components/common'.**
  [`BulkActions.tsx:1-3`](../BulkActions.tsx#L1-L3)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-preview.8d2e31a0"></a>**5. index.ts is a barrel module that re-exports the EventCard, BulkActions, EventFilter and EventList components together with their prop types (EventCardProps, BulkActionsProps, EventFilterProps, EventListProps).**
  [`index.ts:1-12`](../index.ts#L1-L12)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-preview.3ba49e5e"></a>**6. EventList filters events by module when filterModule is set and not 'all'.**
  [`EventList.tsx:55-58`](../EventList.tsx#L55-L58)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-preview.ad3ce1c1"></a>**7. groupEventsByDay groups events into a record keyed by DayOfWeek, keeping only events whose day is one of the five weekdays, and sorts the events within each day by startTime using localeCompare.**
  [`EventList.tsx:21-42`](../EventList.tsx#L21-L42)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-preview.59d4ce8e"></a>**8. EventList renders, for each day in DAYS_ORDER that has events, a heading with the day name and event count and a responsive grid of EventCard components whose selected state comes from selectedIds and whose onToggle invokes onToggle with the event id.**
  [`EventList.tsx:75-102`](../EventList.tsx#L75-L102)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-preview.88e9c7e7"></a>**9. EventCard renders a card div with a left border coloured by colorHex when provided, a selection checkbox checked by selected that invokes onToggle, the module code, an event type badge, an optional group badge, a '⚠️ Unfinalised' warning badge when isUnfinalised and pdfType is 'exam', the time range, the venue prefixed with a location pin, and a warning Alert when isUnfinalised.**
  [`EventCard.tsx:34-97`](../EventCard.tsx#L34-L97)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-preview.a7bf4a97"></a>**10. EventCard detects an unfinalised exam by checking, case-insensitively, whether the event venue or date contains 'unfinalised' or 'tba'.**
  [`EventCard.tsx:24-32`](../EventCard.tsx#L24-L32)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-preview.37b32c6a"></a>**11. EventFilter renders a form-control div containing a label 'Filter by Module' and a select whose value is selectedModule, whose onChange invokes onChange with the new value, and which lists an 'All Modules' option followed by one option per module.**
  [`EventFilter.tsx:13-32`](../EventFilter.tsx#L13-L32)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-preview.affb8b6d"></a>**12. BulkActions computes allSelected as selectedCount equal to totalCount with totalCount greater than zero, and noneSelected as selectedCount equal to zero.**
  [`BulkActions.tsx:22-23`](../BulkActions.tsx#L22-L23)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-preview.ab636713"></a>**13. BulkActions renders a flex container with a 'Select All' outline small Button that invokes onSelectAll and is disabled when allSelected, a 'Deselect All' ghost small Button that invokes onDeselectAll and is disabled when noneSelected, and a span displaying '{selectedCount} of {totalCount} selected'.**
  [`BulkActions.tsx:25-49`](../BulkActions.tsx#L25-L49)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-preview.d7adc797"></a>**14. EventListProps declares events as a ParsedEvent array, selectedIds as a Set of strings, onToggle as a callback that takes an event id string, filterModule as an optional string, and moduleColors as an optional record mapping module codes to color ids.**
  [`EventList.tsx:6-12`](../EventList.tsx#L6-L12)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-preview.acd583f5"></a>**15. EventList renders a 'No events found' message when filteredEvents is empty, appending the filter module when one is active.**
  [`EventList.tsx:104-108`](../EventList.tsx#L104-L108)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-preview.5ea63197"></a>**16. EventCardProps declares event as a ParsedEvent, selected as a boolean, onToggle as a callback that takes no arguments, colorHex as an optional string, and pdfType as an optional 'lecture' | 'test' | 'exam'.**
  [`EventCard.tsx:6-12`](../EventCard.tsx#L6-L12)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-preview.17a645a9"></a>**17. EventFilterProps declares modules as a string array, selectedModule as a string, and onChange as a callback that takes a module string.**
  [`EventFilter.tsx:3-7`](../EventFilter.tsx#L3-L7)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-preview.e0c5eaae"></a>**18. BulkActionsProps declares totalCount and selectedCount as numbers and onSelectAll and onDeselectAll as callbacks that take no arguments.**
  [`BulkActions.tsx:5-10`](../BulkActions.tsx#L5-L10)
